stance_text: Watch — unchanged in substance from the July Hold; the guide trim lowers near-term earnings but buybacks and acquisitions keep per-share growth intact
lens_text: FY2029 adjusted EPS x exit P/E (three-year value)
horizon_text: Fiscal 2029 (year ending early 2030) EPS at an exit P/E, undiscounted
thesis: Per-share earnings compound about 8% a year from 2–3% sales growth, roughly 3% annual share shrink, and a stable-to-better margin; it works if adjusted EBITDA margin holds near 12% while acquisitions add volume.
consensus_view: The stock had recovered from $40.35 in October to $47.44 into the print on municipal strength and record buybacks; the reaffirmed $950–980 million EBITDA guide was the expectation the pre-announcement cut.
variant_view: The market grades CNM on margin, which weakened; per-share value is being driven by capital deployment ($428 million of buybacks year to date, over $250 million of acquired revenue), which held up and is underweighted in a margin-led debate.

catalysts.what_it_proves: Whether results land inside the preliminary ranges and how much of the EBITDA miss is transport cost versus volume
catalysts.value_impact: Within range: no change; below the range low end: bear weight to 35%

catalysts.event: FY2026 results and initial FY2027 guidance
catalysts.what_it_proves: Whether FY2027 adjusted EBITDA grows on the acquisitions and margin stabilizes
catalysts.value_impact: Guide below the FY2026 result fires a kill criterion

catalysts.event: Residential lot development and light commercial recovery
catalysts.what_it_proves: Whether the end markets that drove the trim turn
catalysts.value_impact: Recovery moves weight from bear to bull

premortem.reason: Residential and light commercial stay weak through 2027 while freight inflation persists, and adjusted EBITDA margin slides below 12%.
premortem.signal: Q4 FY2026 adjusted EBITDA margin and the FY2027 margin guide

premortem.reason: Acquisitions hide organic decline; reported growth is all purchased volume.
premortem.signal: Organic sales growth disclosed in the Q3 and Q4 releases

premortem.reason: Buybacks and deals are funded with debt just as EBITDA flattens, and leverage limits flexibility in a downturn.
premortem.signal: Net debt to adjusted EBITDA in the 10-Q and 10-K

premortem.reason: Municipal demand fades as federal infrastructure funding rolls off.
premortem.signal: Municipal end-market commentary and backlog on the December and March calls

kill_criteria.condition: Initial FY2027 adjusted EBITDA guide midpoint below the FY2026 reported result
Net debt above 3.0x trailing adjusted EBITDA

claims.claim: Q3 FY2026 net sales reported on or around December 8, 2026 are between $2,120 million and $2,130 million.
FY2026 adjusted EBITDA reported in early 2027 is at least $950 million.
The midpoint of the initial FY2027 net sales guide is at least 4% above FY2026 reported net sales.
Q4 FY2026 weighted average diluted shares are at least 3% below Q4 FY2025.

change_my_mind: More bullish: Q4 adjusted EBITDA margin back above 12.5% with organic growth positive
More bullish: FY2027 guide with EBITDA growth above sales growth
More bearish: Q3 final results below the preliminary ranges
More bearish: another guide cut, or leverage rising toward 3x to fund buybacks

update.event: Q3 FY2026 preliminary results and FY2026 outlook update (8-K, 2026-11-10); Q2 FY2026 results (8-K, 2026-09-09)
update.expected: July call: FY EPS $2.81 at 16x, operating margin recovering from 9.3%, reaffirmed guide
update.actual: Q2 clean (adj EPS +8%); Q3 preliminary sales +3%, net income -6%, adj EBITDA -1% at midpoints; FY EBITDA guide trimmed to $950-960M; record $171M buyback; three acquisitions with over $250M revenue

thesis_pillars.pillar: Operating margin recovers as integration costs fade
thesis_pillars.note: Transport costs and greenfields; guide to the low end of the margin range
$428M year to date, about 5% of market value

thesis_pillars.pillar: Acquisitions add volume in adjacent categories
